name: agent-skills
description: Felipe Blassioli's personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins — GCP/SRE observability tooling and skill-authoring governance. Public and personal; no warranty.

plugins.name: blassioli
plugins.description: USE AT YOUR OWN RISK — Felipe Blassioli's personal sandbox plugin: GCP observability skills (Cloud Error Reporting triage, Cloud Logging noise triage, error → trace → code root-cause) plus a distributed-systems code reviewer. Experimental; sandbox tier; may graduate to an official plugin as it earns traction.

plugins.name: repo-governance
plugins.description: Release governance for this marketplace: versioning, validating, promoting, and releasing plugins and skills (marketplace.json / plugin.json / registry alignment). For maintainers. Skill authoring and auditing live in the skill-studio plugin.

plugins.name: skill-studio
plugins.description: Author, audit, and enhance Claude skills and plugins: create from scratch or adapt external sources (skill-create), audit for quality, context-efficiency, and portfolio overlap (skill-audit), and improve via an eval/benchmark loop (skill-enhance). Bundles helper subagents and a Python eval harness.
